desc:
Welcome to 2 Player Gym Tycoon! 💪

Team up with a friend and build the ultimate gym! Purchase droppers to earn cash, then buy buttons to unlock powerful workout machines, stylish walls, awesome decorations, OP weapons, and much more.

💰 Earn cash together  
🏋️ Build your own gym  
💪 Unlock workout machines and decorations  
⚔️ Fight with unique gym themed weapons  
💾 All your progress saves!

Can you work together to complete your gym and build the ultimate fitness empire? Play now and begin your workout adventure!
